sections.title: Local writing and cloud saving
sections.text: Drafts, local entries, photos and star arrangements stay in a separate library for each signed-in account on this device. Opening an account does not upload them. On upgrade, older device-wide entries require an explicit choice before a private copy is assigned to one account; the original files are preserved and are not uploaded. Cloud saving sends the entry text, chosen paper and font, weather snapshot, attached photos and original precise location to Starglean's Supabase project. Public entries may be discovered immediately after a successful save and photo validation. Private entries are available only through your account. Cloud content is not end-to-end encrypted.

sections.title: Location and the 200 metre rule
sections.text: On first entry after sign-in, a single explanation lets you enable precise foreground location for nearby memories, weather, place names and your optional Memory Compass. Android also controls system permission. Declining still allows local writing; you can change your choice in Account → Location settings. Find and online-save screens automatically prepare location only while active and authorized; they do not ask again on each visit. No background location is requested. Permission does not publish an entry: cloud saving still requires your final confirmation. Cloud entries retain their original location to check nearby reading. A reader's current precise location is sent for each eligibility check; the app does not deliberately store a route. Stranger responses do not contain the author's identity, precise coordinates or street address. Initial discovery and online responses require current nearby eligibility. Once a note and all its photos have been verified, its opened copy stays in memory when you switch apps and remains readable until you close it or leave Find. Signing out or changing accounts also clears it; it is not restored after the app process ends. Backgrounding pauses location and live checks. If the live session expires, online responses become unavailable, but the already opened copy remains and reporting or blocking can still be submitted with a valid sign-in. Device measurements can be inaccurate or falsified: this is a location-based access rule, not proof of physical presence. Someone who sees your content may still copy it.

sections.title: Weather and place names
sections.text: When the unified location choice and precise system permission are enabled, opening Write automatically uses precise coordinates to obtain model-based weather from Open-Meteo. Place names use the phone's Android geocoding provider. Diary text is not sent for weather or geocoding. Provider requests may include your IP address and have their own retention policies. Leaving the active screen or disabling location stops these requests. Missing weather is shown as unavailable, never replaced with a made-up place or forecast.

sections.title: Sensors and photos
sections.text: Motion sensors detect an intentional shake and help keep the experience steady. The compass uses device orientation plus your current location and a location saved with your own diary. It never points to an anonymous author's location. Selected photos are decoded and re-encoded before upload, removing the original embedded metadata; visible personal details in the picture are not removed. Stranger photos are fetched through a short-lived authorized check and held only in memory by this app, not a public photo URL.

sections.title: Accounts and email
sections.text: Email verification is required before first use; anonymous sign-in is not available. Supabase processes the account and session. Resend delivers verification email through auth.jeternity.top. The app encrypts stored session tokens using Android Keystore and excludes its files from Android backup, so a returning user normally does not need another code. If a previously verified session cannot be checked because the service is unavailable, local memories and drafts remain available offline; cloud actions still require server authorization. A confirmed invalid session returns to sign-in. Never share a verification code. Signing out clears this device's sign-in and does not delete its local entries or sign out other devices. Revocation of this device's server session is confirmed only if the server accepts the request.

sections.title: Reports, blocks and responses
sections.text: Public entries are not pre-approved by a human. You may report content or block its author without learning their identity. Reports and their details are stored for the operator to investigate; a report hides that entry for the reporting reader but is not an automatic worldwide removal. Reactions are delivered as limited counts, not as a reader identity or location. Contact jasonyangjiesen@gmail.com for safety, removal or account questions. No response-time guarantee is promised.

sections.title: Deletion and recovery
sections.text: Cloud deletion withdraws access and removes associated cloud content and photos through a resumable cleanup. A copy already delivered to an open reading may remain in that reader's device memory until they close it or their app process ends. The app removes a linked local entry and its star only after the server confirms entry deletion. Deleting an account removes that account's cloud data; its separate local files are not automatically erased, but a newly created account cannot open that old private library. Save anything you need before deleting an account. Provider logs, security records and backups may expire on their own schedules rather than instantly. Local-only entries cannot be recovered from the server. Cloud restore requires your choice. Constellation sync is opt-in; once enabled it checks for changes while the app is in the foreground, even outside the sync screen. It does not upload local diary text or photos. Conflicting sky versions require your choice.

sections.title: Your encrypted backup
sections.text: Private backup is a manual, password-encrypted export of saved local entries, photos, weather and any remembered precise locations. Drafts, constellation layouts, login credentials, permissions and cloud links are excluded. Choose a strong password and keep it safe; there is no password recovery. The app does not automatically upload a backup, but the file provider you select may sync it elsewhere. Import first decrypts into private temporary storage for verification and your review. It adds missing entries only to the current account's local library, skips identical or previously deleted entries, rejects conflicting versions and does not publish them. Temporary decrypted copies are removed when the review closes; interrupted copies are cleaned when the account next opens. Draft recovery separately preserves original files and available photos privately on this device before replacing a damaged draft, and requires your confirmation. Uninstalling still removes all app-private copies.

sections.title: Limits and service availability
sections.text: The service uses free hosting, database, storage and email allowances. Operations may be unavailable or rate-limited when capacity is reached. Each account may retain up to 1,000 cloud entries, including incomplete uploads and entries whose deletion is still in progress. Completed deletion frees capacity; retained request receipts do not use an entry slot. Local-only entries do not consume cloud capacity. Each on-device account library currently supports up to 2,000 entries and remains subject to device storage and file-size safety limits. Stranger reading has ten server-confirmed opens per account day, resetting at midnight in the account's fixed time zone, without rollover. A lost connection can occur after the server counts an open but before the diary appears. Retrying the same request does not count another open.

sections.title: Responsible sharing
sections.text: Only upload writing and photos you have the right to share. Do not post another person's private information, threats, harassment, exploitation or unlawful content. Avoid including your home address or identifying details in public entries. The operator may withdraw content or restrict an account after a report. Starglean is not an emergency service; contact local emergency services when immediate help is needed.
